keyEvents.text: Goal! Lincoln City 0, Birmingham City 1. August Priske (Birmingham City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Mikkel Ladefoged (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Liam Millar (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury James Beadle (Birmingham City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ethan Laird (Birmingham City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Ben House (Lincoln City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Dom Jefferies (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Ryan Allsop replaces James Beadle because of an injury.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Freddie Draper replaces Dom Jefferies.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Tom Bayliss replaces Ivan Varfolomeev.

Goal! Lincoln City 0, Birmingham City 2. August Priske (Birmingham City) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Christoph Klarer with a headed pass.
Goal! Lincoln City 1, Birmingham City 2. Tom Bayliss (Lincoln City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mikkel Ladefoged.
Delay in match because of an injury August Priske (Birmingham City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Max Bird replaces August Priske because of an injury.
Goal! Lincoln City 1, Birmingham City 3. Alex Cochrane (Birmingham City) left footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ryan Allsop.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Rob Street replaces Reeco Hackett.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Chiedozie Ogbene replaces Ben House.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Demarai Gray replaces Patrick Roberts.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Bright Osayi-Samuel replaces Ethan Laird.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Isaac Olaofe replaces Mikkel Ladefoged.
Substitution, Birmingham City. Marvin Ducksch replaces Jay Stansfield.
Yunus Konak (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
